## Leaning toothpick syndrome (LTS)

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| codemary: "code"
tricky1 <- "double_quote <- \"\\\"\" # or '\"'
single_quote <- '\\'' # or \"'\""
str_view(tricky1)
```

## raw string r"()"

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
tricky2 <- r"(double_quote <- "\"" # or '"'
single_quote <- '\'' # or "'")"
str_view(tricky2)
```

## Wir erinnern uns

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
name_data <- read_csv("./data/name_data.csv")
name_data
```

## separate

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim <- name_data |>
  separate(col = id, into = c("vorname", "name"))
df_delim
```

## separate with sep

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim_2 <- name_data |>
  separate(col = id, into = c("vorname", "name"), sep = ",")
df_delim_2
```

## part of string

## nur 3 Stellen der ICD

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim |> mutate(icd = str_sub(icd, 1, 3))
```

## Filter alle mit "M" in der ICD

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim |> filter(str_detect(icd, "M"))
```

## Bilde logische Variable

Klasse M = 1 oder G = 0

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim |>
  mutate(class_M = ifelse(str_detect(icd, "M"), 1, 0)) |>
  select(name, icd, class_M)
```

## Blutdruck

-   niedrig \< 130
-   grenzwertig \>= 130 - \< 140
-   hoch \>= 140

nur Name, bp1 und class_bp

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim |>
  mutate(
    class_bp = case_when(
      bp1 < 130 ~ "niedrig",
      bp1 >= 130 & bp1 < 140 ~ "grenzwertig",
      bp1 >= 140 ~ "hoch"
    )
  ) |>
  select(name, bp1, class_bp)
```

## Länge der Namen

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_delim |>
  mutate(name_length = str_length(name)) |>
  select(vorname, name, name_length)
```

## Umwandlung

```{r}

#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_date <- name_data |> mutate(gebdat = dmy(gebdat))
df_date
```

## weekday

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_date <- df_date |> mutate(wd_aufnahme = wday(aufnahme))
df_date
```

## weekday with label

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_date <- df_date |> mutate(wd_aufnahme = wday(aufnahme, label = TRUE))
df_date
```

## Aufgabe

Bilde neue Variable für Aufnahme-Datum:\
- Wochentag - Monat - Quartal

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
df_date <- df_date |>
  mutate(weekday = wday(aufnahme, label = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(month = month(aufnahme, label = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(quart = quarter(aufnahme))
df_date
```

# plot

## flights

flights from nycflights flight_data

```{r}
flight_data <- nycflights23::flights
```

## weekday

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flight_data <- flight_data  |> 
  mutate(weekday = wday(time_hour, label = TRUE))
unique(flight_data$weekday)
```

## Warum

So\\.

## Ausschreiben

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flight_data <- flight_data  |> 
  mutate(weekday = wday(time_hour, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE))
unique(flight_data$weekday)
```

## number of flights per origin and weekday

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flight_data |> count(origin, weekday)
```

## Plot

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flight_data |>
  count(origin, weekday) |> 
  ggplot(aes(weekday, n)) +
  geom_col(aes(color = origin)) +
  theme_stata()
```

## Was geht besser?

## entstapeln

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flight_data |>
  count(origin, weekday) |> 
  ggplot(aes(as.factor(weekday), n)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", aes(color = origin)) +
  theme_stata()
```

## Farbe

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
flight_data |>
  count(origin, weekday) |> 
  ggplot(aes(as.factor(weekday), n)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", aes(fill = origin)) +
  theme_stata()
```

# library(tsibble)

index: order from past to present key: variables that define observations over time

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
library(tsibble)
weather <- nycflights23::weather %>%
  select(origin, time_hour, temp, humid, precip)
weather_tsbl <- as_tsibble(weather, key = origin, index = time_hour)
```

## index_by

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
weather_tsbl |>
  group_by_key() %>%
  index_by(year_month = ~ yearmonth(.)) %>% # monthly aggregates
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    ttl_precip = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## autoplot with feasts

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
library(feasts)
weather_tsbl |> autoplot()
```

## grouping

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "code"
weather_tsbl |>
  group_by_key() |>
  index_by(year_month = ~ yearmonth(.)) |> # monthly aggregates
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    ttl_precip = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(year_month, avg_temp)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw()
```
